# libwebp 1.6.0

The image codec statically links the unchanged official libwebp 1.6.0 source,
including its internal SharpYUV library. The library uses the BSD-style license
reproduced in `COPYING.txt`, with the additional patent grant in `PATENTS.txt`.

- Source: <https://storage.googleapis.com/downloads.webmproject.org/releases/webp/libwebp-1.6.0.tar.gz>
- SHA-256: `e4ab7009bf0629fd11982d4c2aa83964cf244cffba7347ecd39019a9e38c4564`
- Upstream: <https://chromium.googlesource.com/webm/libwebp/+/refs/tags/v1.6.0>
- Build: `other/build_image_codec.sh`

The source archive, including the complete upstream contributor list and these
license texts, is included through the project's verified third-party source
manifest. The application and the new helper wrapper remain under the repository
GPLv3 license. Application releases preserve these notices and the matching source archive.
